title: Overgrowth Billing for Lawn Cures — Community Rules & Site Care Grounds Desk Note
content:
A lawn cure under Community Rules & Site Care is billed by how long the lawn went uncured, counted in calendar days from the notice's cure deadline to the work date. The notice is the violation notice most recently served on the plan record, and the work date is the date of the most recent cure outcome recorded as cured by the community.

- More than 14 days: the cure is billed as two visits.
- From 4 through 14 days: the cure is billed as 1.5 visits, that visit cost rounded up to the next whole dollar.
- Fewer than 4 days, and every debris or snow cure: the cure is billed as one visit.

The visit cost is the cost of one contract visit to the site.

## Days on both sides of each threshold

| Days from the cure deadline to the work date | Billed as |
|---|---|
| 3 | one visit |
| 4 | 1.5 visits, rounded up to the whole dollar |
| 14 | 1.5 visits, rounded up to the whole dollar |
| 15 | two visits |

## Worked cases

A hypothetical one-visit cost of $77.00:

- cure deadline 11 May, work date 21 May, 10 days: 1.5 visits is $115.50, rounded up to $116.00;
- 15 days: two visits, $154.00;
- 3 days: one visit, $77.00;
- a debris cure performed 20 days after its deadline: one visit, whatever the days.
